title: Opening
content: This is the first blog entry for the blog section of the xsng website blog as I need to make sure it functions just as intended and nothing else! So it really does though I wish I could inject paragraphs, which I actually could do if I structured this better! title: Blog.js
content: This entry is designed just to test a new formating that allows the addition of paragraphs.
It should work only by modifying the 'content' attribute in the JSON file from text to an array with text.

That way, I can append to the entry a
tag in between every item of the array.

title: Portable devices block
content: As a measure taken out of nostalgia and a wish for in-person social interaction, I have limited the ability to enter the website to non-tablet/mobile devices.

Having access to every corner of the internet inside our pockets with just a few motions has become a problem for many, if not all. We wake up and go to our phones, we fall asleep to our phones, we live with our phones instead of with the people who we love.
I won't be participating and contributing to this disconnection from reality that we all suffer from because of the addictive algorithms and media we are exposed to.
